name: Corinthia Grand Hotel du Boulevard Bucharest
insider_take: This Belle Époque masterpiece sits on Bucharest's legendary Calea Victoriei, where Romanian royalty once strolled and revolutionary history unfolded.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a meticulously restored 1914 building that survived both World Wars and communist rule. Its location on Calea Victoriei places you on Romania's most storied boulevard, steps from the Romanian Athenaeum concert hall and the former Royal Palace. The building's original Art Nouveau details have been preserved alongside modern luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Calea Victoriei for prime people-watching and to witness the stunning architecture of the National Museum of Art across the street, housed in the former Royal Palace.
dont_miss: Take an evening stroll to the nearby Romanian Athenaeum, one of Europe's most beautiful concert halls with its distinctive dome. The Old Town's cobblestone streets and trendy bars are just a 10-minute walk away, while Revolution Square—where Romania's 1989 revolution culminated—is practically at your doorstep.
pros: Historic grand hotel with beautifully preserved Belle Époque architecture
Prime location on Calea Victoriei in central Bucharest
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
Elegant rooms and suites with classic European décor
cons: Historic building may have some structural limitations
